answer: Jury seats are drawn by lottery across separate subnetworks, and a verdict counts only when no two jurors share an operator, so one upheld challenge voids the whole panel and refunds the challenger. Faking that quorum means renting hosts in three unrelated networks and keeping them alive all epoch, which buys three budgets for a single vote. One whisper of a complaint is signal enough to open the audit before the next voyage pays out.
